Subject: Re: ProcurePort webhook: ready to send acceptance signal

Olivia — thanks, and congrats on the signed MOA. Short answers up front: yes, we can accept ProcurePort webhook events; we'll need one small change to the timestamp field and a HTTPS client cert or mTLS option depending on your security posture.

Notes:
- Schema: procureport-webhook-spec-v1.json attached (we validated sample). We prefer ISO-8601 UTC timestamps and a boolean "finalized" flag for acceptance events.
- Security: our recommended path is mutual TLS between ProcurePort and Redwood's ingestion endpoint (ingest-accept@redwoodinference.com). If your infra team can't support mTLS, we can do signed payloads (HMAC) over HTTPS.
- Firewall: allow outbound to 34.201.12.7/32 and 34.201.12.8/32 (ingest endpoints) on 443.
- Cutover window: we can do a staged switch 2026-10-14 02:00–04:00 UTC for Clearline (low-traffic window). We'll keep manual PO upload as fallback for 48 hours.

Next steps I propose:
1) ProcurePort to send a test event to the Redwood sandbox endpoint by 2026-09-24
2) Networking + Security to confirm mTLS credential exchange — I'll loop David for keys
3) Final cutover schedule and DocuSign of the MOA amendment

I've attached the spec and a short onboarding checklist. Jordan can own the test run; Laura will coordinate PO fallback.

Best,
Hannah
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: procureport-webhook-spec-v1.json (JSON, 6KB)
Attachment: onboarding_checklist.pdf (PDF, 72KB)

Thanks Hannah — quick technical note from ProcurePort ops. We can post test events to your sandbox at https://sandbox-ingest.redwoodinference.com/hooks/test. Our default timestamp is epoch_ms; can switch to ISO-8601.

Questions for Redwood (Jordan):
- Do you want test event with "finalized": false and then a follow-up "finalized": true (two-step flow) or a single final event only?
- For mTLS we'll need the Redwood CA cert and the CN pattern to generate client certs.

We will schedule the first sandbox push on 2026-09-24 13:00 UTC unless you ask otherwise.

--
